articles.summary: OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a leading tech-enabled digital finance platform that works with banks to provide financial products and services for everyday Americans, will report financial results for its third quarter 2026 before the market opens on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. Management will host a conference call on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss OppFi's financial results and business outlook. The conference call webcast will be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at investors.oppfi.com . The conference call can also be accessed with the following dial-in information: Domestic: (833) 354-6854 International: (785) 838-9343 Conference ID: OPPFI An archived version of the webcast will be available on OppFi's website. About OppFi OppFi (NYSE: OPFI) is a leading tech-enabled digital finance platform that works with banks to provide financial products and services for everyday Americans.

articles.summary: Launched new Line of Credit product, representing a significant milestone in the expansion of OppFi's product suite Continued execution of product and pricing initiatives designed to expand addressable market opportunities and enhance customer choice Repurchased $6.7 million of common stock during the third quarter under the share repurchase program OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products and services to everyday Americans, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. "The strategic transformation of OppFi continued to gain momentum during the third quarter as we delivered strong execution across a number of priorities that we believe will drive our next phase of growth," said Todd Schwartz, CEO and Executive Chairman.
